temperature.observed: unset: not sent; set to 0.37: sent as temperature

max_output_tokens.observed: unset: not sent; set to 777: sent as max_tokens

max_steps.observed: max_steps 3: 3 model calls, end_state step_limit, harness counted 3

parallel_tool_calls.observed: unset: not sent; set to False: sent as parallel_tool_calls

memory.observed: create_agent has no memory unless a store and memory tools are added; the adapter adds neither

compression.observed: nothing compresses unless SummarizationMiddleware is added; the full history is sent

known_differences: A reply whose only tool calls are malformed ends the run: the router exits when no valid tool call is left, so the error never reaches the model. The adapter labels the trial agent_error (D18)

A malformed call next to a valid one is answered by LangChain's own error result, 'Tool call <name> with id <id> could not be executed - arguments were malformed or truncated.', at the next model call
An unknown tool name gets ToolNode's error result, 'Error: <name> is not a valid tool, try one of [...]'
A tool that raises (an MCP timeout or transport failure) would end the run; the adapter's ToolErrorMiddleware sends 'Error: the tool call failed: <type>: <message>' back instead (D18)
Tool results are sent as a list of text content parts, not a string
max_output_tokens is sent as max_completion_tokens, not max_tokens
Several tool calls in one reply run concurrently (one graph task each), not in order
Tool schemas pass through convert_to_openai_tool, which strips every title and inlines $ref; the finance schemas have neither, so they arrive unchanged

Model names starting gpt-5 drop any temperature other than 1, o1 names send temperature 1 when none is set, and o<digit> names send the system prompt as developer (langchain-openai name rules, no switch); LiteLLM aliases for LangGraph must avoid them
